name: securacv-csi
description: Privacy-preserving WiFi Channel State Information sensing for ESP32-S3. Captures CSI, scrubs identifiers at the interrupt boundary, and exports a 32-dim int8 feature vector at 1 Hz covering motion, breathing, RSSI stats, and frame-rate health. Includes a modular sensing pipeline, a privacy-class-tagged event chokepoint, and a 10-minute sliding-window event bundler.
